requirements.title: Execution Operations API
requirements.description: Implement API endpoints for listing, creating, starting, canceling, and retrying execution runs with filtering

validation.notes: GET /api/v1/execution lists runs with status/mode/kind/date filters
POST /api/v1/execution creates new run, POST start/cancel/retry control lifecycle
Scheduler polls and transitions scheduled runs to running

requirements.title: Execution Operations Interface
requirements.description: Create execution page UI showing pending/running/completed/failed runs with start/cancel/retry controls

validation.notes: ExecutionPage renders run list with status badges and action buttons
Users can view and govern execution runs from the Execution tab
